one_liner: AI media generation (image, video, 3D, audio) via CLI, MCP, and cloud API
blocker: CLI/MCP/API usage consumes paid plan credits (free generations and Unlimited models explicitly excluded), and no public REST endpoint reference is evident in the material

evidence.claim: CLI authenticates via browser sign-in to the user's Higgsfield account, no API key
evidence.quote: Authenticate: run `higgsfield auth login` and complete the sign-in in the browser it opens.

evidence.claim: CLI and MCP share the account's plan credits; free generations and Unlimited models do not apply, implying paid usage
evidence.quote: Both use the same Higgsfield account and plan credits with no API key, and Unlimited models and free generations don't apply to either.

evidence.claim: Official Python SDK uses API key/secret credentials for the Higgsfield API
evidence.quote: Before using the client, set your API credentials as environment variables. You can use either a single key or separate API key and secret

evidence.claim: Vendor documents its own MCP server on its official site
evidence.quote: Add the Higgsfield MCP server URL in your agent's settings and authenticate through your Higgsfield account. No API keys to manage or configure.

evidence.claim: Surface spans images, videos, 3D, audio, and video analysis across 40+ models
evidence.quote: Generate images, videos, 3D assets, audio, and finished-video analysis from the terminal using 40+ Higgsfield AI models

notes: Official MCP & CLI landing at higgsfield.ai/mcp and higgsfield.ai/cli; agent skills installed via `npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills` (generate, soul, product-photoshoot). Cloud API portal (cloud.higgsfield.ai) is behind Clerk sign-in with CAPTCHA/shadow DOM; CLI access falls under Developer Terms in the Terms of Use. Bearer-token phrasing comes from a third-party blog (apidog); pricing ($15-99/mo tiers plus per-generation credits) only from third-party guides, not official sources. No public REST endpoint reference was found in the supplied material.
